WITH qc_by_funding AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing') AS funding_source,
    COUNT(*) AS count
  FROM scanqc sq
  JOIN projects p ON sq.arcref = p.arcregistry
  GROUP BY COALESCE(p.fundflux, 'Missing')
),
total_count AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) AS total FROM qc_by_funding
),
avg_count AS (
  SELECT CAST(SUM(count) AS FLOAT) / COUNT(*) AS average FROM qc_by_funding
)
SELECT 
  qbf.funding_source,
  qbf.count,
  CAST(qbf.count AS FLOAT) / tc.total AS fraction_of_total,
  CAST(qbf.count AS FLOAT) / ac.average AS divided_by_average
FROM qc_by_funding qbf
CROSS JOIN total_count tc
CROSS JOIN avg_count ac
ORDER BY qbf.funding_source;

assumptions.assumption: NULL values in fundflux are treated as a distinct 'Missing' group (per 'with a missing one as its own group')
